$comment: Hand-labelled facets for real Valio catalogue products, the eval set for facets(product) and meets() (D16). Labels come from the product's own data: Valio's ingredient list (synkkaData.keyIngredients) first, then diet tags and allergens, the name last (evidence says which). vegetarianOk = lacto-ovo (no meat, fish or gelatine; dairy and egg are fine); rennet of unstated source is noted, not failed. null = the product's own data cannot tell: claiming ok on it counts as unsafe. animal 'fish' includes shellfish; gelatine counts as 'meat' (slaughtered animals, species unstated). Several items are traps on purpose: names that say vegetable over meat, names that say herring or honey over neither, products with no diet tag, products with no ingredient list.
